title: Mercury dynamical-spectrum row
description: One row in Mercury's per-body action-angle decomposition. Two row_types coexist in one schema with shared required fields and row-type-specific optional fields, mirroring the saturn_rings descriptor pattern: dynamical_mode rows (the 8 angle/action modes from MERCURY_DYNAMICAL_MODES) and precession_contribution rows (the 8 entries in MERCURY_PRECESSION_CONTRIBUTIONS — 5 Newtonian planetary perturbations + GR + solar-J₂ + observed total). Required fields are the ones every row shares; row-type-specific fields are populated where the row_type dictates.

name.description: Row identifier. For dynamical_mode rows: the angle/action variable name (e.g., 'orbital_mean_motion', 'forced_libration', 'eccentricity'). For precession_contribution rows: the contributor name (e.g., 'venus', 'general_relativity', 'OBSERVED_TOTAL').

row_type.description: Row category. dynamical_mode = an angle or action variable in Mercury's action-angle decomposition (orbital, spin, libration, secular-precession angles + eccentricity / inclination / obliquity actions). precession_contribution = one entry in the Le Verrier–Einstein perihelion-precession decomposition (Newtonian perturber / GR / solar-J₂ / observed total).

frequency_per_century.description: Mode frequency in cycles per century. For dynamical_mode rows only; null for precession_contribution. 0.0 indicates a pure-action row (eccentricity / inclination / obliquity).

period_days.description: Equivalent period in days (= 100·365.25 / frequency_per_century for cycle-class modes; 0.0 for pure-action rows). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for precession_contribution.

amplitude_value.description: Characteristic amplitude of the mode in source-units (see amplitude_units). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for precession_contribution.

amplitude_units.description: Units of amplitude_value. For dynamical_mode rows only; null for precession_contribution.

angle_or_action.description: Whether the mode is an angle variable (lives on a torus, periodic mod 2π) or an action variable (slowly varying real interval). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for precession_contribution.

arcsec_per_century.description: Contribution to perihelion precession in arcseconds per century. For precession_contribution rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

physics_class.description: Physics category of the contribution: planetary-mass-driven Newtonian perturbation, post-Newtonian GR Schwarzschild correction, solar quadrupole J₂, or the observed total against which the others sum. For precession_contribution rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. 'high' = published precision is rigorous and modern; 'medium' = mid-20th-century precision; 'low' / 'none' rare for this catalogue.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — historical context, measurement caveats, cross-references to other rows, links to v0.21.x / v0.23.0 / v0.24.x companion catalogues.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper or canonical reference authorising this row's numerical values. Required by the literature_curated adapter for per-row attestation. ISBN form acceptable for textbook citations (e.g., 'isbn:978-0521575973' for Murray-Dermott 1999).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 date when the cited paper / textbook / archive entry was published. Format: 'YYYY' (year only, e.g., '1947' for Clemence where exact issue date is uncertain), 'YYYY-MM' (year + month for journal issues), or 'YYYY-MM-DD' (full date for online papers / specific historic dates like Einstein 1915-11-25). Curator-authored from the cited DOI's metadata. Distinct from attestation.retrieved_at; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:issued.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was first added to the AMSC catalogue or last meaningfully amended. Curator-authored. Lets future MPM auditors trace when the catalogue took its current shape independent of when the underlying papers were published. Aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:dateAccessioned.

source_version.description: Optional. For ephemeris kernels (e.g., 'DE441'), textbook editions ('1st edition'), or archive release tags ('v4.2'). Null for journal papers where the DOI fully resolves the version.
